Definition
[Uniform hyperbolicity] 1. ch7:7.2.1-def-1\group Hyperbolic PDE We say the partial differential operator $\frac{\partial ^2}{\partial t^2} + L$ is (uniformly) hyperbolic if there exists a constant $\theta > 0$ such that \[ \sum _{i,j=1}^{n} a^{ij}(x,t)\xi _i\xi _j \geq \theta |\xi |^2 \tag {4} \] for all $(x,t) \in U_T$, $\xi \in \mathbb {R}^n$.
